purpose: Two independently generated concept references for artistic alignment; not validated recurrent-film paintings.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: opening reference artwork for a continuous surreal nightmare film. One complete landscape image, 1536 by 1024 composition, not a storyboard or collage.
Scene: an immense scarlet-and-obsidian infernal cathedral rises from a slow sea of molten red lava beneath an enormous black eclipsed sun. Its silhouette is a crown of three unequal upward-curving horns. A narrow carved basalt causeway bends from the foreground across the lava into a huge sharply defined dark gateway, leaving a clear navigable passage and layers of smaller architecture beyond. Tiny horned sentinel statues suggest a forbidden rite. This world is monumental, satanic, uncanny, and strangely beautiful.
Visual hierarchy: the cathedral's horned silhouette reads instantly, then the viewer discovers intricate nested archways, miniature staircases and thousands of precisely carved recesses. Show a spacious three-quarter view with foreground, middle distance and background, enough room to travel sideways and through the gateway.
Style: exceptionally crisp, high-fidelity surreal digital artwork, meticulous material relief and controlled hard edges. Black volcanic glass, ribbed iron, carved basalt, lacquer-like crimson mineral surfaces; narrow molten seams illuminate etched ornament and sharp bevels. Restrained flames, clear pools of deep black, precise red edge light. Dominant rich scarlet, vermilion, oxblood and black; only tiny hot orange highlights. The black architecture must retain visible fine detail.
No lettering, border, logos, watermark, collage, heavy smoke, haze, bloom, gray wash, watercolor, painterly smudges or soft focus. No gore. A breathtaking nightmare environment, not a game screenshot or an album-cover layout.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: an alternative opening reference artwork for a continuous surreal nightmare film. One complete landscape image, 1536 by 1024 composition, not a storyboard or collage.
Scene: an impossibly colossal sleeping horned demonic face forms a whole volcanic island in a sea of deep scarlet molten mineral. Seen from an elevated oblique angle, the sculptural face has closed eyes and sweeping black horns; it is an ancient presence made of polished black obsidian, red jasper and intricately ribbed crimson enamel, not human flesh. Curving causeways, tiny pointed shrines and sharply cut terraces grow from its brow and crown, revealing its immense scale. Slow concentric currents around separate dark islands suggest several places that could curl independently. One distant black sun with a razor-thin red rim hangs in a clear wine-red sky. A recurring three-pronged shape appears subtly in the crown architecture.
Visual hierarchy: a bold iconic face-and-horns silhouette occupying the central landscape, surrounded by visible paths and layered terrain. Keep the face readable without making it a close-up portrait; a camera could drift around its temple and enter a dark architectural opening. Unsettling, dreamlike, sacred and satanic; the landscape feels alive before anything actually moves.
Style: exquisitely detailed, razor-sharp surreal digital sculpture and environment art. Hundreds of fine parallel ridges, engraved mineral filigree, precise concentric contours, faceted black glass and tiny red specular reflections. Sculptural smooth areas contrast with dense crisp relief. Strong black negative spaces and saturated crimson surfaces; minimal orange and no other bright colors. Clear deep focus across the whole image.
No lettering, frame, logos, watermark, collage, fog, bloom, pale gray atmosphere, watercolor, brushy softness or video-game interface. No gore. Favor elegant terrifying scale and impossible material geometry over a conventional fantasy monster illustration.
